description: JavaScript source file for QoS settings page in a network device configuration UI, managing QoS policies, UI interactions, and API communications.

methods.name: custom_btn
methods.description: Adds 'pull-right' class to a button element by id.

methods.name: update_str_item
methods.description: Updates QoS policy form fields based on selected index.

methods.name: _update_table_layout
methods.description: Updates QoS policy table display based on data.

methods.name: _prepare_select
methods.description: Prepares QoS category selection options based on bandwidth mode.

methods.name: set_ui_init
methods.description: Initializes UI elements with QoS data.

methods.name: _set_qos_rules_default
methods.description: Resets QoS rule input fields to default values.

methods.name: qos_enable_switched
methods.description: Handles enabling/disabling QoS toggle and UI elements.

methods.name: qos_bw_changed
methods.description: Handles changes in bandwidth mode, updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: qos_cat_changed
methods.description: Handles QoS category change, updates form fields display.

methods.name: get_qos_datas
methods.description: Collects QoS data from form fields into an object.

methods.name: qos_apply
methods.description: Applies QoS settings, updates data, and triggers save.

methods.name: qos_remove
methods.description: Removes a QoS policy entry by index.

methods.name: qos_update
methods.description: Opens dialog to update or add QoS policy.

methods.name: qos_refresh
methods.description: Refreshes QoS data from API.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current QoS configuration via API.

methods.name: set_del_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successful deletion of QoS object.

methods.name: set_add_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successful addition of QoS object.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Generic success callback for setting QoS object.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Error callback for setting QoS object, handles logout on 403.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends QoS data to API for setting, handles different actions.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after retrieving QoS data, initializes UI.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Error callback for retrieving QoS data, handles logout on 403.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Fetches QoS data from API.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initial page setup, fetches QoS data.
